description: This file contains implementation of functions to send various message types (HELLO, ACK, REQUEST, REPLY, BYE) over TCP sockets, within the context of an advanced network service container. It handles message construction, memory management, and socket communication for protocol-specific messages in the Ansc Lpcco Tcp Object.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpSendHello(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a HELLO message over the specified socket, including party address, port, and name information.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpSendAck(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Constructs and sends an ACK message, including party name, over the specified socket.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpSendRequest(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,void * buffer,ULONG ulSize,ULONG ulSeqNumber,ULONG ulReqType)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a REQUEST message with payload, sequence number, and request type.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpSendReply(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket,void * buffer,ULONG ulSize,ULONG ulSeqNumber,ULONG ulReqType,ULONG ulRepCode)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a REPLY message with payload, sequence number, request type, and reply code.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS AnscLpccoTcpSendBye(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject,ANSC_HANDLE hSocket)
methods.description: Constructs and sends a BYE message including party name over the specified socket.
